decision.explanation: The question asks for the medium of "El derecho de nacer." Two distinct works share this title: one is a 1981 Mexican TV series (a telenovela), and the other is a 1952 Mexican film. Both are valid referents under the same title and are supported directly by the original source texts (D1S1 and D2S1). The term 'telenovela' (proposed in C2) is a genre within the broader category of 'TV series,' and since the question asks for the medium, 'TV series' is sufficient and already included. There is no conflict between the two answers because they refer to different works.
